skills.skill_desc:
Whenever Aulus deals skill damage to a unit, he gains an enhanced Basic Attack for 2s (capped at 4s).
Enhanced Basic Attack: Aulus raises his axe and slams it into the ground, dealing 120 (+12*Hero Level)<font color="fba51f"> (+75% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a line and recovering 15<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> HP. Enemies hit are slowed by 10% for 1s. Aulus also gains 0.5 Attack Range and 20% Attack Speed for 1s.
Enhanced Basic Attack deals 240 (+24*Hero Level)<font color="fba51f"> (+75% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to creeps.

Aulus starts accumulating <font color="a6aafb">Fighting Spirit</font>, removes all slow effects, and gains 30% extra Movement Speed for 5s.

If Aulus does not take high-level control effects within 2s, he will enter the <font color="a6aafb">Enraged</font> state and gain Control Immunity.

Aulus swings his axe, dealing 240<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area and stunning them for 0.3s.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Aulus dashes forward and smashes the ground, dealing 240<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies.

Aulus repeatedly swings his axe at nearby enemies, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> each time. After 4 strikes, Aulus briefly charges before unleashing a wider slash, dealing 450<font color="fba51f"> (+180% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a large area.

During this skill, Aulus gains 20% Damage Reduction and a short burst of Movement Speed with each slash.
